records.claim: It is not known if sertraline can make it harder to get pregnant. One study found that women who take sertraline or some other SSRIs have a slightly lower chance of getting pregnant. However, some of the conditions that sertraline is used for, including depression, can make it harder to get pregnant. This makes it hard to know if the medication, the condition being treated, or other factors are affecting a person’s ability to get pregnant.
records.source_section: I take sertraline. Can it make it harder for me to get pregnant?
